# Learn with Anil PYQs (learnwithanil.in)

> Previous year question papers (PYQs) of Indian government recruitment exams with answers from the official final keys, a short explanation for every question, and online practice: question-by-question practice with a timer, timed tests, subject-wise (sectional) tests and topic-wise quizzes. Made by Jupudi Anil Kumar, a civil-services educator in Hyderabad.

Key facts:
- 20,685 questions from the official papers of 36 exams: APPSC Group-II, APPSC Group-I, UPSC CAPF (AC), UPSC EPFO (APFC, EO/AO, PA), UPSC CSE Prelims, SSC CGL, RRB NTPC, RRB Group D, SSC GD Constable, TS Police SI, TS Police Constable, TGPSC Group-I Services, TGPSC Group-II Services, TGPSC HMWSSB Manager (Engineering), APPSC AMVI (Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector), TGPSC AMVI (Assistant Motor Vehicles Inspector), APPSC Executive Officer Grade-III (Endowments), APPSC Analyst Grade-II (A.P. Pollution Control Board), APPSC Assistant Environmental Engineer (A.P. Pollution Control Board), APPSC Assistant Statistical Officer (ASO), AP DSC (Teacher Recruitment Test), APPSC Forest Range Officer (FRO), AP Police SI, AP Police Constable, RPF SI, RPF Constable, TNPSC Group 4, KEA FDA & SDA, MPSC Group C, GSSSB CCE, UPSSSC Inter Level Mains, UPPSC RO/ARO, UKPSC Lower PCS, CG Vyapam Group 2, SBI PO, IBPS SO.
- Answers come only from the official keys published by the recruiting body (APPSC, TSLPRB/TGPRB, UPSC, TSPSC/TGPSC). For a few old APPSC papers (Group 1 2019 and 2023, Group 2 2019) APPSC printed only the correct answer; there the other three options are written by Learn with Anil and labelled.
- Languages: English with Telugu for APPSC, TS Police and TGPSC exams; English with Hindi for UPSC exams.
- Free: every question and its correct answer from the official key are public on the paper, subject and question pages, with the explanations of the first 10 questions of each paper, and a daily question of the day.
- All-in-One Pass: ₹45 once for 12 months, covering everything on the site: every previous paper of every exam (and exams added later) with every explanation, practice in the app, timed tests, sectionals and study tools, every mock test series and the study books. Nothing else is sold.
- Bahubali Prelims – APPSC Group-II Screening Test Series (Mock Tests): 10 full-length mock tests (Mock 1 (free), Mock 2, Mock 3 and Mock 4 are available now; the other 6 mocks are coming soon), included in the ₹45 All-in-One Pass. https://learnwithanil.in/appsc-group-2/mock-test.html
- UPSC EPFO Mock Test Series: 10 mock tests, coming soon, included in the ₹45 All-in-One Pass. https://learnwithanil.in/upsc-epfo/mock-test.html
- Mission CGL – SSC CGL Mock Test Series (Tier-I & Tier-II): 13 full-length mock tests (Tier-I Mock 1 and Tier-II Mock 1 are available now; the other 11 mocks are coming soon), included in the ₹45 All-in-One Pass. https://learnwithanil.in/ssc-cgl/mock-test.html
- Mission Khaki – TS Police SI Prelims 2026 Test Series: 10 full-length mock tests (Mocks 1–5 are available now; Mocks 6–10 are coming soon), included in the ₹45 All-in-One Pass. https://learnwithanil.in/ts-police-si/mock-test.html
- Mission Khaki – Constable: TS Police Constable Prelims Test Series: 10 full-length mock tests (Mock 1 (free), Mock 2, Mock 3, Mock 4 and Mock 5 are available now; the other 5 mocks are coming soon), included in the ₹45 All-in-One Pass. https://learnwithanil.in/ts-police-constable/mock-test.html
- APPSC EO Grade-III Test Series – Paper I & Paper II Full-Length Mocks: 6 full-length mock tests (All 3 mocks (6 papers) are available now), included in the ₹45 All-in-One Pass. https://learnwithanil.in/appsc-endowment-officer/mock-test.html
- SBI PO Prelims Mock Test Series (Latest Pattern): 10 full-length mock tests (Mock 1 is available now; the other 9 mocks are coming soon), included in the ₹45 All-in-One Pass. https://learnwithanil.in/sbi-po/mock-test.html
- IBPS SO Prelims Mock Test Series (2026-27 Pattern, with Professional Knowledge): 40 full-length mock tests (Mock 1 is available now; the other 9 mocks are coming soon), included in the ₹45 All-in-One Pass. https://learnwithanil.in/ibps-so/mock-test.html
- Bahubali Test Series (APPSC Group 2 Mains): 24 full-length tests, included in the ₹45 All-in-One Pass. https://learnwithanil.in/appsc-group-2/bahubali-test-series/
- Not affiliated with APPSC, TSLPRB, UPSC, TGPSC or any recruiting body.

## Study material (PDF books)
- [History and Culture of Andhra Pradesh for APPSC Group-I & Group-II, 2026-27 (English Medium)](https://learnwithanil.in/appsc-group-1/notes/): 221-page PDF by Jupudi Anil Kumar, 17 chapters · all 207 APPSC AP-history PYQs with official keys · 30 Group-I Mains answer frames · 204 practice MCQs. Chapters: Land, Prehistory and the Origins of the Andhras; Buddhism and Jainism in Andhra; The Satavahanas; Ikshvakus, Salankayanas, Pallavas and Vishnukundins; Eastern Chalukyas of Vengi, Renati Cholas and the Beginnings of Telugu; The Kakatiyas; Nellore Chodas, Musunuri Nayakas, Reddi Kingdoms, Velamas and Gajapatis; Vijayanagara and Andhra; Telugu Language and Literature, 11th–17th Centuries; The Qutb Shahis of Golconda; Europeans, the Company and British Rule in Andhra; Social and Cultural Awakening: Reformers, Missionaries, Press and Libraries; The National Movement in Andhra, 1885–1947; Folk, Tribal and Performing Arts; The Andhra Movement and Andhra State, 1953; Andhra Pradesh, 1956–2014; Bifurcation, 2014 and Its Impact. Included in the ₹45 All-in-One Pass. Free sample chapter (PDF, shareable): https://learnwithanil.in/LearnWithAnil-AP-History-APPSC-Group-1-Group-2-Free-Sample.pdf
- [Mental Ability for APPSC Group-I & Group-II, 2026-27 (English Medium)](https://learnwithanil.in/appsc-group-1/notes/): 283-page PDF by Jupudi Anil Kumar, 25 chapters · 269 shortcuts · all 212 APPSC PYQs solved · 500 practice questions. Chapters: Number system, digits, remainders, HCF & LCM; Simplification, approximation, surds & equations; Percentage; Profit, loss & discount; Ratio, proportion, partnership & mixtures; Averages; Ages; Simple & compound interest; Time & work, pipes & cisterns; Time, speed & distance (trains, boats, races); Mensuration & geometry; Permutations, combinations & probability; Number & letter series, missing numbers; Analogy & odd one out; Coding–decoding & symbol substitution; Blood relations; Directions & distance; Seating, ranking & puzzles; Clocks & calendars; Figures, cubes & dice; Syllogism, Venn diagrams & logic; Statements: assumptions, arguments, courses of action, assertion–reason; Data interpretation: tables, bar, line & pie charts; Basic statistics: mean, median, mode, dispersion; Administrative & psychological abilities. Included in the ₹45 All-in-One Pass. Free sample chapter (PDF, shareable): https://learnwithanil.in/LearnWithAnil-Mental-Ability-APPSC-Group-1-Group-2-Free-Sample.pdf
- [Public Administration and Governance for APPSC Group-I Mains (Paper III, Section B), 2026-27 (English Medium)](https://learnwithanil.in/appsc-group-1/notes/): 116-page PDF by Jupudi Anil Kumar, 12 chapters · 24 cartoon meme breaks · all 30 Section B questions (2020–2025) with answer pointers. Chapters: Public Administration: Meaning, Nature and Scope; Administration in Ancient and Medieval India; Legacy of British Rule and the Evolution of the Civil Service; Government Policies, Interventions and Implementation; Development Administration and Development Processes; Civil Society, NGOs and Other Stakeholders; Statutory, Regulatory and Quasi-Judicial Authorities; Civil Services in a Democracy; Good Governance; E-Governance; Citizen's Charter, Right to Information and Public Service Acts; Social Audit. Included in the ₹45 All-in-One Pass.
- [Ethics in Public Service and Basic Knowledge of Laws for APPSC Group-I Mains (Paper III, Section C), 2026-27 (English Medium)](https://learnwithanil.in/appsc-group-1/notes/): 141-page PDF by Jupudi Anil Kumar, 15 chapters (9 ethics + 6 law) · 30 cartoon meme breaks · all 30 Section C questions (2020–2025) with answer pointers. Chapters: Ethics and Human Interface; Human Values: Harmony in Existence and Relationships; Gender Equality and the Agents of Value Education; Lessons from Great Leaders, Reformers and Administrators; Attitude, Social Influence and Persuasion; Emotional Intelligence; Public Service, Professional Ethics and Codes; Leadership Ethics, Work Culture and Ethics in Organisations; Ethics in International Relations; Corruption, Lokpal and Lokayukta; The Constitution as the Basic Law; Civil and Criminal Law; Labour Laws: Social Welfare Legislation and the Labour Codes; Cyber Law: The IT Act, Cyber Crime and Cyber Security; Tax Laws: Income, Profits, Wealth, Corporations and GST; Company Law Basics. Included in the ₹45 All-in-One Pass.
- [APPSC Group-II Micro-Syllabus 2026 (Notification 37/2026), English Medium](https://learnwithanil.in/appsc-group-2/notes/): 47-page PDF by Jupudi Anil Kumar, 9 subjects · 267 sub-topics · 1,004 PYQs mapped · 112 current affairs (2025–26). - [ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ ఆర్థిక వ్యవస్థ: క్రిస్ప్ నోట్స్ 2026-27 (తెలుగు మాధ్యమం)](https://learnwithanil.in/appsc-group-2/notes/): 46-page PDF by Jupudi Anil Kumar. Chapters: Science, Technology and Innovation: Policies, Institutions and Missions; Emerging Technologies and Nanotechnology; ICT, Digital India and Cyber Security; Space Technology; Defence Technology; Nuclear Technology and India's Nuclear Policy; Energy: Demand, Efficiency, Security and Conventional Sources; Renewable and Clean Energy; Ecology, Ecosystems and Biodiversity; Natural Resources, Forests, Mining and Food Security; Pollution and Waste Management; Climate Change, Global Environmental Issues and Sustainable Development; Environmental Laws, Impact Assessment and Disaster Management; Biotechnology; Human Health, Diseases and Public Health; Intellectual Property Rights in Science and Technology; Group-I Mains: Previous Questions. Included in the ₹45 All-in-One Pass.
- [Hindu Philosophy & Temple System for APPSC EO Grade-III, 2026-27 (English Medium)](https://learnwithanil.in/appsc-endowment-officer/notes/): 167-page PDF by Jupudi Anil Kumar, 10 chapters · 24 meme breaks · 291 Paper II PYQs (2023 & 2026). Chapters: Ramayanam; Mahabharatham; Bhagavatham and the Puranas; Temple Agamas and Worship; Hindu Festivals and Classical Arts; Vedic Culture; Philosophies, Cults and Gurus; Hindu Family: Structure, Adoption and Succession; The A.P. Endowments Act, 1987: Administration, Income and the Executive Officer; Land Records and Endowment Lands. Included in the ₹45 All-in-One Pass. Free sample chapter (PDF, shareable): https://learnwithanil.in/LearnWithAnil-EO-Grade-3-Hindu-Philosophy-Temple-System-Free-Sample.pdf
- [Hindu Philosophy & Temple System for APPSC EO Grade-III, 2026-27 (Telugu Medium)](https://learnwithanil.in/appsc-endowment-officer/notes/): 177-page PDF by Jupudi Anil Kumar, 10 chapters · 24 meme breaks · 291 Paper II PYQs (2023 & 2026) · Telugu medium. Chapters: రామాయణం; మహాభారతం; భాగవతం, పురాణాలు; దేవాలయ ఆగమాలు, పూజా విధానం; హిందూ పండుగలు, శాస్త్రీయ కళలు; వైదిక సంస్కృతి; తత్వాలు, సంప్రదాయాలు, గురువులు; హిందూ కుటుంబం: నిర్మాణం, దత్తత, వారసత్వం; ఏపీ దేవాదాయ చట్టం, 1987: పరిపాలన, ఆదాయం, ఎగ్జిక్యూటివ్ ఆఫీసర్; భూ రికార్డులు, దేవాదాయ భూములు. Included in the ₹45 All-in-One Pass. Free sample chapter (PDF, shareable): https://learnwithanil.in/LearnWithAnil-EO-Grade-3-Hindu-Philosophy-Temple-System-Telugu-Free-Sample.pdf

## About
- [About Jupudi Anil Kumar](https://learnwithanil.in/appsc-group-2/about/): civil-services educator, 2.5 years of UPSC, APPSC and TGPSC teaching and mentorship.
- [Fund Learn with Anil](https://learnwithanil.in/funders.html): a one-person project built to be student-friendly and to democratise learning, with the goal of 1 lakh PYQs of various government exams under one roof for ₹45; Anil needs help from funders, which in turn helps him help the students.
